label: Congruence closure
subgoals: Merge the classes of every asserted equality
Merge f(s) with f(t) whenever s and t share a class
Repeat until stable and count the classes

label: Chains of congruence
subgoals: Propagate congruence upward through nested applications
Count the classes after the last merge

label: Ackermann's reduction
subgoals: Count the distinct applications of the function
Add one consistency constraint per unordered pair
